**The document does not give the MathVision scores for either model.**

What it does say:

- **Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking** achieves state-of-the-art results on MathVision, along with MathVista<sub>mini</sub>, MathVerse<sub>mini</sub>, ZeroBench, LogicVista, and VisuLogic (p. 14). Since it is called state of the art, it presumably scores at or above Gemini 2.5 Pro (thinking) on MathVision, but no numbers are given.
- **Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct** achieves the best reported MathVision result among non-thinking or low-thinking-budget models (p. 14).
- The abstract names MathVision as one of the visual-math benchmarks where Qwen3-VL leads (p. 1).

The per-benchmark scores are in a flagship results table that Section 5.2 refers to (p. 14), but that table is not in this version of the document. The tables that are included (Tables 5–12) cover text-only benchmarks and ablations, not MathVision. To get the exact figures, check the original paper at arxiv.org/abs/2511.21631.
